methods.optimus: Optimus 5-Prime variable-length model (Sample et al. 2019; trained on 25-100 nt random 5' UTRs in an MPRA, HEK293T). Input: whole UTR if len <= 100 (optimus_input='full'), else the 100 nt immediately upstream of the start codon ('last100'); U->T, left-padded with N (zeros) to 100. Output inverse-scaled with the training-set MRL mean 5.2699 / sd 1.3552 (recomputed from GEO GSM4084997 with the notebook's split). Validation of this numpy forward pass on the notebook's held-out sets: random test Pearson r = 0.915 (n=7600), human test r = 0.882 (n=7600). Predicted MRL is for the UTR in the MPRA reporter context (eGFP CDS), not the endogenous mRNA; UTRs < 25 nt are outside the training length range.
methods.measured: Cao et al. 2021 transcript-level TE (rpkm_riboseq/rpkm_rnaseq) from the 5UTR_Optimizer repo; matched by Ensembl transcript ID ignoring version (source uses an older Ensembl release than this file). ambiguous=true: a sibling isoform of the same gene has an identical TE in that cell type, i.e. reads were not resolved between isoforms; treat as gene-level, not isoform-level.
methods.tss_note: Heuristic vs the gene's reference isoform (first chosen: MANE_Select/canonical), from Ensembl exon coordinates (lookup/id?expand=1). 5' UTR genomic segments = exons clipped at the annotated CDS start. class: reference; alt_first_exon = first exons do not overlap genomically; utr_splicing = first exons overlap but the set of 5' UTR introns inside the region covered by both UTRs differs; length_only = same start codon and one UTR sequence is a 3'-suffix of the other (TSS shifted within the same exon structure); alt_start_codon = otherwise, the annotated start codon differs; other = none of these. features lists every criterion that applies.
methods.fold: local folding: per-nt unpaired probabilities from RNAplfold (RNA.pfl_fold_up, W=150, L=100, ulength 1) on the UTR + first 30 nt of CDS (punp reported for the UTR only); structure (dotbracket, layout2d, hairpins) = MFE with maximal base-pair span 100 nt (RNAfold --maxBPspan 100), so long-range pairs are dropped. mfe / mfe_global = unrestricted global MFE (old field, kept for reference); mfe_local = MFE of the span-restricted structure. ViennaRNA default energy parameters, 37 C.
methods.motifs: pipeline/motifs.py find_motifs(); positions 0-based half-open in the 5' UTR. uAUG (strength = Kozak class, -3 purine / +4 G; cite calvo2009) with uORF_stop for uORFs ending in the UTR; nearcog = CUG/GUG/ACG/UUG in strong context only (kearse2017); TOP = >= 5 pyrimidines starting within 4 nt of the 5' end (TOP-like rule of thoreen2012; Ensembl 5' ends are approximate); G4 = (G3+N1-7){3,}G3+ (huppert2005 folding rule; kumari2007 for 5' UTR translational repression), not structure-tested; TISU = AAS-AUG-GCGGC at the main start for UTR <= 30 nt (elfakess2008); kozak_main = -6..+4 context (kozak1986). Dropped (no definition verified in time): PRTE, polyU.

mrl.coef_units: change in target per +1 SD of the feature (standardized ridge coefficient)
mrl.dataset: Sample et al. 2019 GEO GSE114002 / GSM4084997, varying-length (25-100 nt) eGFP library, total_reads >= 10: all 'human' 5' UTR fragments + random-library test split (top 100 by reads per length)
mrl.target: mean ribosome load (MRL, polysome profiling, HEK293T)
mrl.fold_method: ViennaRNA 2.8.0: punp = RNAplfold-style unpaired prob (pfl_fold_up u=1 W=150 L=100) on UTR+first 30 nt CDS; mfe = UTR MFE with max bp span 100; cap_dG = MFE of first 50 nt
mrl.leakage: Optimus varying-length model was trained on the random-library training split only; rows here are the human set and the random test split, so Optimus never saw them. Optimus architecture/hyperparameters were however chosen on this library.
mrl.applicability: trained on 25-100 nt UTR fragments in an eGFP reporter; per_isoform mrl_pred for longer endogenous UTRs extrapolates (length / uAUG counts beyond the training range)
mrl.physics_note: physics = app/src/analytic.js expected() at app default params, log(initiations/min); physics_fitted = 4 params refit per fold (see physics_fit)

te.coef_units: change in target per +1 SD of the feature (standardized ridge coefficient)
te.dataset: Cao et al. 2021 (Nat Commun) HEK293T transcript TE (Andreev 2015 Ribo-seq/RNA-seq), 5' UTR + CDS from GENCODE v19 pc_transcripts (exact versioned ID match)
te.filters: rnaseq_counts >= 50, riboseq_counts >= 10, te > 0, CDS starts ATG, 5' UTR >= 10 nt, no sibling isoform with bit-identical TE (unresolved quantification)
te.fold_method: ViennaRNA 2.8.0: punp = RNAplfold-style unpaired prob (pfl_fold_up u=1 W=150 L=100) on UTR+first 30 nt CDS; mfe = UTR MFE with max bp span 100; cap_dG = MFE of first 50 nt
te.leakage: none from Optimus (MPRA-trained). Ridge features/filters were not tuned on this set.
te.within_gene_note: pairs = same-gene isoforms with different 5' UTRs; out-of-fold predictions (gene held out); ctrl_longer_CDS = predicts the isoform with the longer CDS has higher TE (no 5' UTR information; flags isoform-quantification/length effects in the TE table)

physics_fit.dataset: Sample 2019 MRL rows used for models.mrl (same rows, same 5 folds)
physics_fit.note: score = log(initiations/min) from analytic.js expected(); linear map to MRL fit on training folds; Nelder-Mead (<=80 evals) from app defaults, params clipped to the app slider ranges; hairpins from a local MFE fold (max bp span 100); all other params at app defaults.

genes.blurb: In mouse ATF4, positive-acting uORF1 promotes reinitiation at inhibitory uORF2; eIF2 phosphorylation delays reinitiation so ribosomes bypass uORF2 and reach the ATF4 coding region.

main_kozak.method: rule-based: strong = purine (A/G) at -3 AND G at +4; adequate = exactly one of these; weak = neither (positions relative to first base of the start codon = +1; main start = Ensembl-annotated start codon, non-AUG flagged in tags; a -3 position upstream of the cap counts as not purine). score not computed (null).

fold.method: local folding: per-nt unpaired probabilities from RNAplfold (RNA.pfl_fold_up, W=150, L=100, ulength 1) on the UTR + first 30 nt of CDS (punp reported for the UTR only); structure (dotbracket, layout2d, hairpins) = MFE with maximal base-pair span 100 nt (RNAfold --maxBPspan 100), so long-range pairs are dropped. mfe / mfe_global = unrestricted global MFE (old field, kept for reference); mfe_local = MFE of the span-restricted structure. ViennaRNA default energy parameters, 37 C.

measured.note: Cao et al. 2021 transcript-level TE (rpkm_riboseq/rpkm_rnaseq) from the 5UTR_Optimizer repo; matched by Ensembl transcript ID ignoring version (source uses an older Ensembl release than this file). ambiguous=true: a sibling isoform of the same gene has an identical TE in that cell type, i.e. reads were not resolved between isoforms; treat as gene-level, not isoform-level.

tss_note.text: reference isoform for comparison (MANE Select / canonical)

main_kozak.method: rule-based: strong = purine (A/G) at -3 AND G at +4; adequate = exactly one of these; weak = neither (positions relative to first base of the start codon = +1; main start = Ensembl-annotated start codon, non-AUG flagged in tags; a -3 position upstream of the cap counts as not purine). score not computed (null).

fold.method: local folding: per-nt unpaired probabilities from RNAplfold (RNA.pfl_fold_up, W=150, L=100, ulength 1) on the UTR + first 30 nt of CDS (punp reported for the UTR only); structure (dotbracket, layout2d, hairpins) = MFE with maximal base-pair span 100 nt (RNAfold --maxBPspan 100), so long-range pairs are dropped. mfe / mfe_global = unrestricted global MFE (old field, kept for reference); mfe_local = MFE of the span-restricted structure. ViennaRNA default energy parameters, 37 C.

measured.note: Cao et al. 2021 transcript-level TE (rpkm_riboseq/rpkm_rnaseq) from the 5UTR_Optimizer repo; matched by Ensembl transcript ID ignoring version (source uses an older Ensembl release than this file). ambiguous=true: a sibling isoform of the same gene has an identical TE in that cell type, i.e. reads were not resolved between isoforms; treat as gene-level, not isoform-level.

fold.method: local folding: per-nt unpaired probabilities from RNAplfold (RNA.pfl_fold_up, W=150, L=100, ulength 1) on the UTR + first 30 nt of CDS (punp reported for the UTR only); structure (dotbracket, layout2d, hairpins) = MFE with maximal base-pair span 100 nt (RNAfold --maxBPspan 100), so long-range pairs are dropped. mfe / mfe_global = unrestricted global MFE (old field, kept for reference); mfe_local = MFE of the span-restricted structure. main_kozak.method: rule-based: strong = purine (A/G) at -3 AND G at +4; adequate = exactly one of these; weak = neither (positions relative to first base of the start codon = +1; main start = Ensembl-annotated start codon, non-AUG flagged in tags; a -3 position upstream of the cap counts as not purine). score not computed (null).

fold.method: local folding: per-nt unpaired probabilities from RNAplfold (RNA.pfl_fold_up, W=150, L=100, ulength 1) on the UTR + first 30 nt of CDS (punp reported for the UTR only); structure (dotbracket, layout2d, hairpins) = MFE with maximal base-pair span 100 nt (RNAfold --maxBPspan 100), so long-range pairs are dropped. mfe / mfe_global = unrestricted global MFE (old field, kept for reference); mfe_local = MFE of the span-restricted structure. ViennaRNA default energy parameters, 37 C.

measured.note: Cao et al. 2021 transcript-level TE (rpkm_riboseq/rpkm_rnaseq) from the 5UTR_Optimizer repo; matched by Ensembl transcript ID ignoring version (source uses an older Ensembl release than this file). ambiguous=true: a sibling isoform of the same gene has an identical TE in that cell type, i.e. reads were not resolved between isoforms; treat as gene-level, not isoform-level.

main_kozak.method: rule-based: strong = purine (A/G) at -3 AND G at +4; adequate = exactly one of these; weak = neither (positions relative to first base of the start codon = +1; main start = Ensembl-annotated start codon, non-AUG flagged in tags; a -3 position upstream of the cap counts as not purine). score not computed (null).

fold.method: local folding: per-nt unpaired probabilities from RNAplfold (RNA.pfl_fold_up, W=150, L=100, ulength 1) on the UTR + first 30 nt of CDS (punp reported for the UTR only); structure (dotbracket, layout2d, hairpins) = MFE with maximal base-pair span 100 nt (RNAfold --maxBPspan 100), so long-range pairs are dropped. mfe / mfe_global = unrestricted global MFE (old field, kept for reference); mfe_local = MFE of the span-restricted structure. ViennaRNA default energy parameters, 37 C.

main_kozak.method: rule-based: strong = purine (A/G) at -3 AND G at +4; adequate = exactly one of these; weak = neither (positions relative to first base of the start codon = +1; main start = Ensembl-annotated start codon, non-AUG flagged in tags; a -3 position upstream of the cap counts as not purine). score not computed (null).

fold.method: local folding: per-nt unpaired probabilities from RNAplfold (RNA.pfl_fold_up, W=150, L=100, ulength 1) on the UTR + first 30 nt of CDS (punp reported for the UTR only); structure (dotbracket, layout2d, hairpins) = MFE with maximal base-pair span 100 nt (RNAfold --maxBPspan 100), so long-range pairs are dropped. mfe / mfe_global = unrestricted global MFE (old field, kept for reference); mfe_local = MFE of the span-restricted structure. ViennaRNA default energy parameters, 37 C.

findings.title: MDM2: short P2 leader translated better than long P1 leader
findings.evidence: MDM2-224's first exon (chr12:68809002-68809086) lies in intron 1 of the P1 transcripts (internal P2 promoter; 89-nt leader, no fully upstream uORF), MDM2-209 starts in P1 exon 1 (same exon as MANE; 305-nt leader, 2 uORFs), and both use the same start codon (chr12:68809212).
